taylor: Hey team — first week on runtime, trying to build from source on my dev box (Ubuntu 22.04, CUDA 12.2, driver 535). Build fails at link with undefined references to cublasLt symbols.

 taylor: Error snippet I see in ninja:
```
/usr/bin/ld: /home/taylor/redwood/inference/runtime/lib/libcublaslt.a(cublasLt_ops.o): in function `cublasLtCreate'
undefined reference to `__cudaRegisterFatBinary'
``` 

 mika: Welcome! :wave: quick checks — are you building inside a container or on host? if container, is libcuda visible?

 taylor: Host. I can run nvidia-smi fine. CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-12.2, ldconfig shows libcudart.so.12 -> /usr/local/cuda-12.2/lib64/libcudart.so.12

 jordan: Try `ldd` on the failing binary/object to see missing shared libs. Also check the link line for `-lcudart` and the order (objs then -lcudart).

 eli: Another common thing: we sometimes accidentally link static cublas libraries older than runtime lib. run `readelf -d <file> | grep NEEDED` and `nm -g` on the archive to confirm symbols.

 taylor: ran ldd on the test binary — libcudart.so.12 => /usr/local/cuda-12.2/lib64/libcudart.so.12 (0x7f...)

 mika: Can you paste the full link command? Also check if CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS has `-Wl,--no-as-needed` removed or not, linker pruning can drop symbols referenced from static libs.

 taylor: link line: `g++ ... build/runtime/liblibruntime.a -lcudart -lcublas -lcudnn -Wl,--start-group -lcublasLt -Wl,--end-group -o bin/runtime` — I do see cublasLt inside a static archive earlier.

 jordan: If cublasLt is in a static archive, symbols may be pulled in wrong order. Move -Wl,--start-group / end-group around static libs or prefer shared `-lcublasLt` if available. Also ensure /usr/local/cuda-12.2/lib64 is before /usr/lib in rpath or LD_LIBRARY_PATH.

 eli: For immediate workaround, try replacing `-lcublasLt` with the full path to the shared lib `/usr/local/cuda-12.2/lib64/libcublasLt.so` in the link line.

 taylor: Thanks! I'll try that. If it still fails I'll paste full build log. Appreciate the quick help :heart:
